## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman known for her careful, tactful, and broadminded guidance. She possesses a natural gift for easily winning and holding the affections of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Stacy was hired as Avonlea's first female schoolteacher, maintaining perfect order among her pupils without ever resorting to corporal punishment. Upon her arrival, she quickly became a popular and encouraging figure who introduced field afternoons and organized a student [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. Recognizing the potential in her students, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and others for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. She spent the following years mentoring the class through their studies, and upon the end of her term, she shared an emotional farewell with her students before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went on to tie for first place on the exam.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a trusted teacher, mentor, and role model for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). After taking over the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, she inspires [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through innovative teaching methods, encourages her creative writing, and advises her on pursuing advanced studies. Miss Stacy organizes the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) preparation class specifically to help bright students like [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) work toward becoming certified teachers.

- Friend of — good friends and role model  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
